subject: I'm not sure if you know
author: Captain Cakewalk
body:
I'm not sure if you know this but if you are still looking to get that elusive 20x Boost achievement the Toy WTR is fantastic for it! Just go onto I-88 and go into oncoming and boost away! 🙂 Its much easier and you should be able to get it no problems ^^ Its a real relief as Ive been playing BP for over 700 hours now and it was only because of the Toy Cars that I could keep my cool long enough to get it LOL 😉

 

Also, they should certainly add Burning Routes to the Toy Cars as you could then have things like Toy Civillian and so on 😎

 

Revenge is a dish best served at 200mph!
